scope_measured_before_authorizing.basis: Counted from the plan's own ledger. One row is a genuine no-op (before_sha256 == staged_sha256) and is named here rather than rounded away: the previous cycle's authorization recorded 0 no-ops out of 168, and a count that never varies is a count nobody is taking.

every_difference_explained.method: Each of the 168 planned rows was diffed, staged against accepted, and required to fall into a named class. Counting fragments was NOT used as the acceptance test: it moved in the right direction for all three plans built during this cycle, including the two that were corrupting text.
every_difference_explained.whole_file_text_preservation: All 165 markdown files: the full text, normalised for whitespace and bullet markers and excluding provenance lines, is IDENTICAL before and after. Zero pages gained or lost text. Rejoining may only move bullet boundaries; if it ever adds or drops a word this check fails.
every_difference_explained.rejoin_pages_reviewed: All 18 read individually: area51 (3 sites), autodbf, buildlmdb, canary, cdx (3), cnx, commit, dir, dotscript, educational_use, else, export, gps, rel, security, sftp, sql, sqlsel. Each renders as a coherent sentence; no welded list items and no mid-token joins.

defects_found_and_fixed_during_this_cycl.note: THREE plans were built and discarded before this one, each on review rather than on a gate failure. Every one of them reported PASS_PLAN_ONLY with findings=0.
defects_found_and_fixed_during_this_cycl.corruption_240_byte_spills: A length heuristic joined field-boundary spills with a space, changing words: 'not the command name.' became 'not the comm and name.', '(AIF-043).' became '(AIF-04 3).'. Six rows affected, three of them in topics (VDISK, APPGUI) with no page among the 164, so half the damage was latent.
defects_found_and_fixed_during_this_cycl.welding_of_lists: With no minimum line length, wrapped-prose joining fused list items: model.md tables/records/fields/indexes/relations, expression.md numeric/character/date/logical, script.md loops, projection.md, buffering.md working/persisted state. About thirty items across eight pages.
defects_found_and_fixed_during_this_cycl.resolution: The spill join is no longer a heuristic. src/help/helpdata_export_dbf.cpp documents HELP_LINE as a deliberate pseudo-memo reassembled by LINE_NO + PART_NO, under a heading reading DO NOT 'FIX' IT; the renderer now uses that key on BOTH render paths. The prose join takes a measured 60-character wrap-band floor, where the join-length distribution jumps from 13 occurrences in the 40-59 band to 116 in 60-69 and 577 in 70-79.

known_and_accepted_at_authorization.residual_fragmentation: Some bullets remain split where the rule deliberately under-joins: a continuation starting with a capital, and the line-oriented kinds SYNTAX/USAGE/ARGUMENT/EXAMPLE, which are excluded because they are indented command forms rather than prose. Under-joining leaves a fragment; over-joining creates a falsehood. This cycle produced examples of the second and they were caught by hand.
known_and_accepted_at_authorization.attention_pages: FOX|DO and FOX|RUN, both status=partial, INCLUDE_PARTIAL_HELP_REFERENCE. Correct and expected; documented as 'use DOTSCRIPT instead'.
known_and_accepted_at_authorization.orphan_pages: 47 orphan pages in the accepted command reference, pre-existing since before 2026-07-18 and untouched by this cycle.
